user.title: Connect to Synology RT6600ax
user.description: Creates a router device with summaries and a list of clients. Client entities are optional. WOL is only sent manually. We recommend HTTPS and certificate verification.

data_description.port: Usually 8001 for HTTPS or 8000 for HTTP.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable is an explicit option for an untrusted local certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Restore login to SRM
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current data of the same router. Client identities will be preserved.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection to the same router
reconfigure.description: Use when changing IP or login details. The identity of the configuration will remain the same.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to SRM. Check the address, port and availability of the router.
error.invalid_host: Enter only IP address or hostname, without protocol, port and path.
error.invalid_auth: Login to SRM failed. Verify account details and permissions.
error.permission_denied: The account does not have permission to read router clients.
error.invalid_certificate: The certificate cannot be verified. Verify the hostname and certificate; only consciously turn off authentication.
error.two_factor_required: SRM requires an additional login factor. This flow is not yet supported by the integration. Don't turn off 2FA automatically.
error.unsupported_api: The router does not support the required client API v5.
error.unsupported_response: The client API returns a different structure. Run tools/probe.py local diagnostics as instructed. DevTools are not needed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This version supports one router. To change the address, use Reconfigure with an existing integration.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The connection settings have been changed.

init.title: Router clients
init.description: The client interval can be set from 5 seconds (default 30 s). The table of all clients remains with the router. The selected client entities and trackers are in the Integrated Clients device under this integration.

data.create_clients: Allow the selected entities to connect
data.client_entities: Clients with a separate connection entity
data.remove_unselected: Remove unselected client entities of this integration
data.traffic_source_unit: Verified input unit at router speed

data_description.tracker_clients: The selection turns on the tracker in the Integrated Clients device. An empty selection means no trackers.
data_description.poll_interval: 5 to 3600 seconds. Default value is 30. Five seconds means 12 queries per minute; these are not immediate events.
data_description.client_entities: An empty selection will not create any client entities. The list of all clients will remain with the router.
data_description.remove_unselected: It will also clean up entities automatically created by version 0.1.0. Removes unselected entities and their settings from the HA registry; their automation may need to be modified. It will not remove the router or other integrations.
data_description.traffic_source_unit: Set only after validating against SRM. The table output will always be KB/s (1000 B/s). Unverified speeds will remain blank.
data_description.traffic_rx_direction: Download and upload refer to the client. Until the direction is verified, the original RX/TX are only in details.

ram_calculated.name: RAM – usage excluding cache and buffers
